adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new refresh logic performs a direct `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and never calls the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper (unlike Google/Office365/Zoom/Webex/etc. which were updated to use it). Since `refreshOAuthTokens` is the mechanism introduced in this PR to route refreshes through `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is set, Salesforce refreshes will not go through the sync endpoint in credential-sync deployments, creating inconsistent/broken behavior for that feature.
